text: Mouser Electronics is part of TTI, Inc.'s group: TTI lists Mouser Electronics in its 'TTI Family of Specialists', the group of companies it says is made up of TTI, Mouser Electronics, Sager Electronics and the Exponential Technology Group.

source.quote: The TTI Family of Specialists made up of TTI, Mouser Electronics, Sager Electronics, and the Exponential Technology Group
